Check a table for common data problems

Source: R/inspect.R
validate_c4e.Rd

Runs four checks on a c4e_tbl and reports them:

Usage

validate_c4e(x)

Arguments

x

A c4e_tbl.

Value

A tibble of class c4e_checks with one row per check: check, status ("ok" or "problem") and detail. Printing it lists the checks.

Details

  • duplicate rows: more than one row for a unit and date;

  • empty indicators: registered columns with no value at all;

  • units without data: units whose series and indicators are all missing, e.g. locations outside the raster;

  • date gaps: units of a long table missing dates inside their period, given the time step.

See also

summary.c4e_tbl()

Examples

x <- update_meta(
  tibble::tibble(ID = c("1", "1", "2"), date = as.Date("2022-01-01") + c(0, 2, 0),
                 value = c(28, 31, NA)),
  key = "ID", date_col = "date", shape = "long", time_step = "day")
validate_c4e(x)
#> ✔ duplicate rows
#> ✔ empty indicators
#> ✖ units without data: 1 unit: 2
#> ✖ date gaps: 1 unit miss dates inside their period: 1
